ModMetaData.name: Evergrowth – Plant Growth Control
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Full control over how plants grow – crops, trees and wild plants. Every plant from every mod, live, no restart.
NEW IN 1.6 - Separate growth speed for crops, trees and wild plants - Bigger harvests: crop yield and wood from trees (x0.1 – x10) - Wild plants grow back faster after cutting, grazing or fire – great for animal pens and cold maps - Poor soil does not slow growth (optional) - No crop blight (optional) - One-click presets: Vanilla / Easy farming / Lush world
COLD - Plants keep growing below 0 °C (default: down to -10 °C, vanilla 0 °C). - Much higher frost tolerance: plants go leafless and die only in hard frost. - Adjustable growth temperatures (minimum, full-speed range, maximum).
GROWTH (all off by default) - Faster growth: x0.1 to x20. - Growing day and night (24/7). Plants under a roof still need lamps. - Grow time in days – separately for crops and for trees.
PLANTS - Choose which plants are cold-hardy: wild plants of cold biomes, all wild plants and trees, all plants including crops, or your own pick from a searchable list of every plant from every mod.
Plants only ever get more tolerant, never less; changes made by other mods are kept. Safe to add to or remove from an existing save. Works with any plant mod (VE Plants, Alpha Biomes, Biomes!...). Czech and English. Requires Harmony.
